editorial:
If you grew up watching the little blue creatures on Saturday mornings, this live-action and animated mix brings them to life in a whole new way. The story kicks off when the evil wizard Gargamel chases the Smurfs out of their magical village, sending them tumbling into modern-day New York City. Suddenly, these tiny three-apple-high heroes are stuck in Central Park, trying to survive the Big Apple while figuring out how to get home. Papa Smurf, Clumsy, and the rest of the gang team up with a kind couple to stay hidden and find a way back. The vibe is bright, silly, and packed with slapstick humor that keeps things moving.

The blend of animation and real-world settings works surprisingly well, and the voice cast brings plenty of energy. Kids will love the fast-paced action and silly jokes, while adults might find some of the humor a bit over-the-top. The pacing rarely slows down, though the story is pretty predictable. If you want a fun family night, stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Gargamel captures the Smurfs and tries to use their magic to become all-powerful. Papa Smurf and the others escape with help from their human friends, and Clumsy finally proves his bravery by saving the day. The Smurfs open a portal back to their village, but Gargamel follows them through. In the end, the Smurfs trick Gargamel and send him back to the human world, closing the portal behind him. They celebrate their victory and return home safely, ready for their next adventure.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family adventures and animated characters.
